set.body:
Why
image4s optimized Separable execution needs to ping-pong primitive MutableNDArray workspaces across axes without freezeCopy. PreparedDirectNeighborhoodExecutor previously accepted only NDArray sources.

Scope
- Add MutableNDArray source overloads for prepared primitive Float/Double/Byte/Short runs
- Add mutable-to-mutable prepare entry points
- Reject aliased source/destination storage
- Cover agreement with immutable sources and freezeCopy-chained multi-pass

Acceptance
- Mutable source runs match immutable source results
- Two-pass ping-pong matches freezeCopy chaining
- Aliased prepare/run fail before mutation
- JVM and Scala.js stencil suites pass
set.title: Add MutableNDArray primitive source reads to prepared stencil executors
